name: intro
arrangement: Sparse fingerpicked acoustic steel-string guitar with delicate hammer-ons on the B string, accompanied by an upright felt piano playing sparse bass roots and sustained upper dyad intervals.

name: verse_1
arrangement: Subtle muted kick on beats 1 and 3, dry side-stick rimshot on beat 3, round melodic electric bass playing roots and fifths, accompanied by the fingerpicked acoustic guitar.

name: pre_1
arrangement: Bowed double bass drone enters; palm-muted electric guitar pulses eighth notes as light ride cymbal bell taps build gradual dynamic momentum toward the chorus.

name: chorus_1
arrangement: Full acoustic strumming spreads stereo wide; live snare hits on 2 and 4 with crisp wire response; clean Telecaster plays the melodic hook counterpoint; bass locks in melodic motion.

name: turnaround
arrangement: Two-measure breath; rhythm section drops out leaving fingerpicked acoustic guitar hovering on a suspended 9th and a soft brushed cymbal swell.

name: verse_2
arrangement: Drums re-enter with subtle snare ghost notes; electric bass plays active passing notes; single-coil electric guitar provides subtle spring-reverbed chord stabs.

name: pre_2
arrangement: Warm analog organ pad swells underneath; floor tom eighth-note pulse drives urgency while acoustic guitar opens from palm mute into ringing arpeggios.

name: chorus_2
arrangement: Full band texture with open hi-hat wash; lead electric guitar adds gritty chime behind vocal phrases; bass pushes subtle upper-octave syncopations.

name: bridge
arrangement: Stripped down texture centering on intimate upright felt piano and bowed cello; introduces a bittersweet Neapolitan Cmaj7 chord substitution for emotional lift before dropping to a dry dominant stop.

name: final_chorus
arrangement: Climactic return of the band with doubled acoustic strums, wide ride cymbal, driving live kick and snare, and soaring Telecaster obligato weaving through vocal pauses.
chords: Bm - A - Gmaj7 - Em7 - F#m7 - Bm

name: outro
arrangement: Rhythm section completely drops; a solitary fingerpicked acoustic guitar lingers over resolving chords as felt piano sustains a final unresolved Bm(add9) into tape hiss.
